title: Intestinal infection and fecal shedding of infectious SFTS virus reveal a potential fecal–oral transmission route
abstract: Abstract Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) is an emerging tick‐borne viral disease with a case fatality rate of 7.8% and no approved therapy. Gastrointestinal symptoms are frequently reported in patients, yet whether the intestinal tract serves as a site of viral infection or contributes to transmission has remained unclear. To address this, we combined clinical cohort analysis with mouse models and human intestinal organoids. In a multicenter cohort of 752 patients, 62.9% presented with gastrointestinal symptoms that correlated with serum viral load. Fecal calprotectin was elevated in the majority of tested samples, pointing to frequent intestinal inflammation during SFTS. In mice, the virus infected enterocytes and intestinal stem cells, causing epithelial injury, barrier disruption and diarrhea. These cellular and histopathological findings were recapitulated in human intestinal organoids, which also showed inflammatory reprogramming of the epithelium. Notably, replication‐competent virus could be isolated from the feces of infected mice and from patients with acute SFTS. Together, these observations indicate that SFTSV targets the intestinal epithelium and that infectious virus shed in feces may enable a fecal–oral transmission route. This adds to the growing evidence for non‐vector‐borne transmission and carries implications for infection control and public health surveillance.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,粪-口 传播 可能是 SFTSV 的可行途径,这对感染控制和公共卫生 监测 策略具有影响。

abstract_zh: 摘要 严重发热伴血小板减少综合征(发热伴血小板减少综合征)是一种新出现的蜱传病毒性疾病,病死率为 7.8%,且尚无批准的治疗方法。患者经常报告胃肠道症状,但肠道是否是病毒感染部位或导致 传播 仍不清楚。为了解决这个问题,我们将临床 队列研究 分析与小鼠模型和人类肠道类器官相结合。在 752 名患者的多中心 队列研究 中,62.9% 出现与血清病毒载量相关的胃肠道症状。大多数测试样本中粪便钙卫蛋白升高,表明 发热伴血小板减少综合征 期间肠道炎症频繁发生。在小鼠中,该病毒感染肠上皮细胞和肠干细胞,导致上皮损伤、屏障破坏和腹泻。这些细胞和组织病理学发现在人类肠道类器官中得到了重现,也显示了上皮的炎症重编程。值得注意的是,可以从受感染小鼠和急性 发热伴血小板减少综合征 患者的粪便中分离出具有复制能力的病毒。总之,这些观察结果表明,SFTSV 以肠上皮为目标,并且粪便中排出的传染性病毒可能实现粪-口 传播 途径。这增加了越来越多的非 媒介 传播的 传播 的证据,并对感染控制和公共卫生 监测 产生影响。

title: A review of ticks and tick-borne diseases in Southeast Asia: identifying priorities, hurdles, and opportunities for health and knowledge gain.
abstract: Ticks and tick-borne diseases (TBDs) in Southeast Asia are poorly understood, confounding surveillance, and mitigation opportunities. Herein, we conducted a survey of experts (n = 25) to identify tick species and TBDs of greatest concern to Southeast Asia, 'drivers' which may alter their impacts, and research hurdles. These experts identified Dermacentor auratus, Haemaphysalis longicornis, Rhipicephalus linnaei, Amblyomma testudinarium sensu lato, Ixodes granulatus, Ixodes persulcatus, and Rhipicephalus microplus as ticks of greatest concern; and rickettsioses, severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus, borreliosis, Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever, anaplasmosis, tick-borne encephalitis, and novel tick-borne viruses as TBDs of greatest concern. Land-use change was expected to have the largest impact on ticks and TBDs, followed by climate change, invasive species, and drug resistance. The three biggest research hurdles were lack of funding, lack of awareness, and lack of taxonomic expertise. Addressing these near-term priorities and hurdles while harmonizing research efforts and surveillance within, and between countries may help lay the groundwork for future research and surveillance efforts in the region, and may also enhance the region's preparedness, ultimately leading to better health outcomes for the region.

title_zh: 对东南亚蜱虫和 蜱媒 疾病的回顾:确定健康和知识获取的优先事项、障碍和机会。
source_body_en: Ticks and tick-borne diseases (TBDs) in Southeast Asia are poorly understood, confounding surveillance, and mitigation opportunities. Herein, we conducted a survey of experts (n = 25) to identify tick species and TBDs of greatest concern to Southeast Asia, 'drivers' which may alter their impacts, and research hurdles. These experts identified Dermacentor auratus, Haemaphysalis longicornis, Rhipicephalus linnaei, Amblyomma testudinarium sensu lato, Ixodes granulatus, Ixodes persulcatus, and Rhipicephalus microplus as ticks of greatest concern; and rickettsioses, severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus, borreliosis, Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever, anaplasmosis, tick-borne encephalitis, and novel tick-borne viruses as TBDs of greatest concern. Land-use change was expected to have the largest impact on ticks and TBDs, followed by climate change, invasive species, and drug resistance. The three biggest research hurdles were lack of funding, lack of awareness, and lack of taxonomic expertise. Addressing these near-term priorities and hurdles while harmonizing research efforts and surveillance within, and between countries may help lay the groundwork for future research and surveillance efforts in the region, and may also enhance the region's preparedness, ultimately leading to better health outcomes for the region.
abstract_zh: 人们对东南亚的蜱虫和 蜱媒 疾病 (TBD) 知之甚少,这混淆了 监测 和缓解机会。在此,我们对专家(n = 25)进行了一项调查,以确定东南亚最关心的蜱虫种类和 TBD、可能改变其影响的“驱动因素”以及研究障碍。这些专家将金皮皮蜱 (Dermacentor auratus)、长角血蜱 (Haemaphysalis longicornis)、林奈扇头蜱 (Rhipicephalus linnaei)、睾丸钝蜱 (Amblyomma testudinarium sensu lato)、颗粒硬蜱 (Ixodes 管理)、全沟硬蜱 (Ixodes persulcatus) 和微小扇头蜱 (Rhipicephalus microplus) 列为最受关注的蜱类;立克次体病、发热伴血小板减少综合征病毒、疏螺旋体病、克里米亚-刚果出血热、无形体病、蜱媒 脑炎和新型 蜱媒 病毒是最受关注的待定疾病。预计土地利用变化对蜱虫和 TBD 的影响最大,其次是气候变化、入侵物种和耐药性。三个最大的研究障碍是缺乏资金、缺乏认识和缺乏分类学专业知识。解决这些近期优先事项和障碍,同时协调国家内部和国家之间的研究工作和 监测,可能有助于为该地区未来的研究和 监测 工作奠定基础,也可能加强该地区的准备工作,最终为该地区带来更好的健康结果。
